out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed during time of inspection when operating a wok burner, Handling a raw shell egg with their bare hands, then proceed to too without washing hands or putting on gloves, handle a wok utensil and then proceed to add sauces from a cart and handle RTE veggies.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. PIC STOPPED EMPLOYEE AND HAD THEM WASH THEIR HANDS. ALL CONTAMINATED SURFACES WERE THEN CLEANED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Upstairs bar handwashing sink did not have a handwashing poster
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC agreed to replace a handwashing poster

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed in Walk in Cooler, raw whole crabs were being stored over cooked ready to pork and fried chicken on a shelving unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged walk in cooler, so the raw shells crabs were being stored under the cooked, Ready to Eat foods.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: 4 drawer reach in bar cooler, housing Half and half did not have a thermometer inside the cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC moved half and half to a cooler with a thermometer inside of it. Agreed to not store TCS products in the 4 drawer reach in bar cooler

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed in the Walk in cooler: lemongrass and Raw Chicken being stored not he floor of the walk in cooler, under shelving and rolling speed rack carts
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved lemongrass and raw Chicken off the floor of the walk-in cooler

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed during of inspection, bus pans and various cambro storage containers were being wet stacked after being washed and sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. PIC and EHS reviewed wet stacking and bacteria breeding from wet stacking. PIC agreed to train staff that day to stop wet stacking and develop methods by next inspection to facilitate air drying

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers (pro-fish) were observed reused for the storage of various vegetables and pre-made food throughout the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed stop use of the single use containers and have all single use “pro-fish”containers phased out of use by next inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: Observed during time of inspection cardboard was being used inside the Walk in cooler and on shelving throughout the kitchen as liners.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC agreed to discontinue use of the cardboard shelf liners in the walk in cooler and throughout the facility by next inspection.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: CUT CABBAGE, RAW SPROUTS
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: OWNER ADDED TIMES ON STICKY NOTES DURING INSPECTION

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. OBSERVED A FOOD EMPLOYEE EATING AT AN ACTIVE PREP STATION IN KITCHEN
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. CDI: FOOD EMPLOYEE MOVED FOOD TO DINING AREA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED IN THE KITCHEN HANDWASHING SINK: RAW CHICKEN TO BE CUT AND PREPPED. OBSERVED IN THE UPSTAIRS HANDWASHING SINK: TWO CONTAINERS FULL OF UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: CHICKEN AND UTENSILS MOVED OUT OF THE HANDWASHING SINK. CEASE USING HANDWASHING SINKS FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN HANDWASHING.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. OBSERVED MOST SHELLSTOCK TAGS UNDATED.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. CDI: EHS DISCUSSED DATING SHELLSTOCK TAGS WITH THE DATE OF THE LAST PIECE SREVED.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED SERVING WARE RUN THROUGH THE DISHMACHINE DOWNSTAIRS AND MACHINE WAS MEASURING UNDER 10PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: CEASE USING THE DOWNSTAIRS DISHMACHINE FOR SANITIZING. THE THREE VAT SINK WAS SET UP FOR SANITIZING 50-200PPM CHLORINE (BLEACH) AND DISHES PROPERLY SANITIZED.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: OBSERVED THE ICE MACHINE TO HAVE MOLD BUILDUP ON THE INTERIOR FLAP AND ON THE INTERIOR SIDES.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. ICE MACHINE MUST BE DRAINED THEN CLEANED TO REMOVE BUILD-UP. INCREASE THE CLEANING FREQUENCY OF THE ICE MACHINE. DUANGRAT'S THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 06/23/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN THE SILVER KING SLIDING DOOR COUNTER TOP COOLER NEAR THE DEEP FRIERS: CUT LETTUCE AT 55.1F, COOKED CHICKEN AT 55F. COOLER MEASURED 55.9F. OBSERVED IN THE 3-DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT) UPSTAIRS: LETTUCE AT 48F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PIC STATED COOLER IS TURNED OFF AT NIGHT AND FOOD WORKERS RESTOCK IN THE MORNING. STATED FOOD WAS IN COOLER FOR ~1HR, ALL FOOD PLACED IN WALK-IN COOLER. CEASE PUTTING FOOD IN THIS UNIT UNTIL IT CAN HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. LETTUCE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED COOKED RICE NOODLES COVERED AND STACKED VERY THICK IN A LARGE CONTAINER IN WALK-IN COOLER AFTER COOKING THIS MORNING.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: PIC HAD FOOD WORKER SPLIT UP RICE NOODLES IN MULTIPLE PANS AND PLACED BACK IN WALK-IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED A COCKROACH ON THE WALL ADJACENT TO THE DEEP FRIER ON THE MAIN FLOOR. OBSERVED MANY BABY COCKROACHES CRAWLING OUT OF A CREVICE IN THE DISHMACHINE UPSTAIRS. OBSERVED A STICKY TRAP UPSTAIRS TO HAVE AN ABUNDANCE OF BABY COCKROACHES.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. CURRENT PEST CONTROL FREQUENCY IS MONTHLY, INCREASE PEST CONTROL TO WEEKLY UNTIL INFESTATION UNDER CONTROL. PIC CALLED PEST CONTROL AT TIME OF INSPECTION, THEY ARE TO ARRIVE TONIGHT.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped COCKROACHES were found on the premises UPSTAIRS IN THE BEVERAGE AREA OFF THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. ALL TRAPS NEED TO BE CHECKED REGULARLY BY PEST CONTROL AND REMOVED AND REPLACED.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED A CONSIDERABLE AMOUNT OF BUILDUP UNDER THE THREE-VAT SINK AND DISHMACHINE AREA ON THE MAIN LEVEL. THICK BUILDUP WAS ALSO OBSERVED UNDER THE COOKLINE ON THE MAIN LEVEL, AND MULTIPLE GREASE TRAPS ARE LEAKING ONTO THE FLOOR CREATING FURTHER HARBORAGE CONDITIONS. OBSERVED THICK GREASE BUILD-UP IN THE HOT WATER HEATER ROOM FROM THE GREASE TRAP INSIDE OF IT.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. FACILITY MUST BE CLEANED TO ENSURE HARBORAGE CONDITIONS DO NOT EXIST. PLEASE INCREASE THE CLEANING FREQUENCY OF THE FACILITY TO ENSURE BUILDUP DOES NOT OCCUR.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: OBSERVED A HOLE IN THE SCREEN OF THE WINDOW IN THE DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: WINDOW CLOSED DURING INSPECTION. CEASE USING THIS WINDOW UNTIL SCREEN IS REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED FOOD IN THE DRY STORAGE, WALK-IN FREEZER, AND WALK-IN COOLER TO BE DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALL FOOD MUST BE LIFTED TO BE AT LEAST 6IN ABOVE THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED A RICE SCOOP SOAKING IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER. OBSERVED PLASTIC TO GO CONTAINERS IN MULTIPLE DRY STORAGE CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: RICE SCOOP REMOVED FROM WATER. PLASTIC CONTAINERS REMOVED FROM DRY STORAGE CONTAINERS AND OWNER ORDERING SCOOPS. PLEASE USE SCOOPS AND ENSURE HANDLES ARE POINTED UP AND OUT OF THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED THE DISHWASHING MACHINE ON THE MAIN AND UPPER FLOOR MEASURING ~0-10PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CDI: OWNER CONTACTED REPAIR SERVICE AT TIME OF INSPECTION. DISHHWASHERS ADJUSTED TO MEASURE ~50PPM CHLORINE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. OBSERVED CHLORINE (BLEACH) TEST STRIPS EXPIRED AND NO QUATERNARY TEST STRIPS PRESENT AT FACILITY FOR THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA SANITIZER USED ON MAIN LEVEL BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a CHLORINE (BLEACH) AND QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: Observed improper disposal of sewage (i.e. mop water, water used to clean refuse containers). OBSERVED GREASE TRAP IN HOT WATER HEATER ROOM LEAKING OR OVERFLOWING ONTO THE FLOOR. GREASE IS THICK ON THE FLOOR AND PRESENT ON THE WALLS. OBSERVED THE GREASE TRAP UNDER DISHMACHINE ON THE MAIN FLOOR TO HAVE A BUILDUP OF GREASE UNDERNEATH FROM LEAKING OR OVERFLOWING.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. GREASE TRAPS MUST BE CLEANED AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY SO LEAKING OR OVERFLOWING DOES NOT OCCUR. DUANGRAT'S THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 06/23/2025) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED HOLES THROUGH THE WALL NEAR THE GREASE TRAP AT THE MAIN FLOOR THREE-VAT SINK. OBSERVED HOLES THROUGH THE WALL UPON ENTRANCE INTO THE KITCHEN PREP AREA ON THE IMMEDIATE LEFT WALL.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. ALL HOLES AND CRACKS IN WALLS MUST BE REPAIRED AND SEALED.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE ENTIRE FACILITY IN NEED OF CLEANING. THERE IS CONSIDERABLE BUILD-UP OF GREASE AND DEBRIS ON THE FLOOR UNDERNEATH COOKING EQUIPMENT AND DISHWASHING EQUIPMENT INCLUDING SINKS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. DUANGRAT'S THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 06/23/2025) Page 4 of 5
